html: † סֵ֫פֶל n.[m.] bowl (√ unknown; perhaps foreign word; Assyrian saplu, bowl, basin (DlHWB 508 SchrCOT 2 K 9:2) [occurs as object of tribute or plunder]; NH = BH; 𝔗 סִיפְּלָא bowl, basin, ChrPal. Aramaic ܣܝܦܠܐ (wash-) basin SchwallyIdiot. 64; Arabic سِفْلٌ bowl, jar FlLevy NHWB iii. 320; Kl. Schr. ii. 556 f. is perhaps loan-word Frä67 f.);—abs. מְלֹא הַסּ׳ Ju 6:38; for drinking, cstr. סֵפֶל אַדִּירִים 5:25 a bowl of (fit for) nobles, huge bowl (GFM).
